description: This Java class CustomFeignErrorDecoder implements the Feign ErrorDecoder interface to handle and process error responses from Feign client calls, specifically decoding error responses into application-specific exceptions.

classes.name: CustomFeignErrorDecoder
classes.description: A custom implementation of Feign's ErrorDecoder to process HTTP error responses and convert them into specific application exceptions.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the response generated from a Feign client call into an exception based on the HTTP status code.

methods.name: extractBankingCoreGlobalException
methods.description: Extracts and deserializes a SimpleBankingGlobalException from the response body.
